0022600170.text: The Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak and 1 game back in the Pacific, 9th in the West) host the Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak, 2.5 games back in the Pacific, 12th in the West) in Golden State's eighth game of the season. The Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 131-122 in Phoenix on October 24, 2026, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Golden State is without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Draymond Green and Stephen Curry are day-to-day with rest and are game-time decisions, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery).
